<subject>Southern Public Account</subject>
<body>
There is a £280,000 daily overdraft facility that has been taken out of our CES 39999 pool for Southern Public's accounts for January. If I remember correctly, this has happened over the past few months. This facility approval never made it into Halcyon's Core Banking System, so I created a ticket 149375 (Halcyon's approval #).

Halcyon's Credit Risk team says this facility does not exist and there is a CES person on this team.

Please give us the GMS approval number, and if you know the RiskWorks reference number. If you have a copy of the approval form, fax it to me at +44 20 9258 9831.

Thanks.
</body>
